_meta.description: Ayah-number mapping between KFGQPC Hafs/Kufi and Warsh/Madani-last datasets.
_meta.method: Independent character-level Levenshtein alignment per surah after Arabic normalization, projected back to ayah boundaries. Al-Fatihah basmala handled explicitly.
_meta.important: targets is always an array. Do not assume 1:1 mappings. For scholarly/canonical boundary evidence, cross-check against quranpedia/qiraat-ayah-map.

1.note: Basmala: independently numbered as Hafs/Kufi 1:1, but not independently numbered in the Warsh/Madani-last dataset.
